info.title: imamzain.org API
info.description:
REST API for imamzain.org — Islamic content management, digital library, gallery, forms, and contest.

**Authentication:** Protected endpoints require a Bearer JWT. Obtain one via `POST /api/v1/auth/login`.

**Language:** Send `Accept-Language: ar` (or any supported ISO 639-1 code) to receive translated content. Falls back to the default translation when the requested language is unavailable.

cover_image_id.description: ID of an existing media record used as cover image

translations.description: Must include exactly one translation with is_default: true

attachment_ids.description: Ordered list of media IDs to attach to the post
